spec: docs/internal/User-Doc-Deposit/SETTLEMENT_FLOW_LEDGER_PREREG.md section 3.2 (lines 86-92, the four facts), section P8a (lines 326-329, the roll schedules) and section 3.1b (lines 72-84, the P9 products)
rules: status 'sourced' means the quoted sentence is in the filing named by `accession`, read out of the RAW recorded bytes under data/raw/recorder/sec_fund_filings/ and not out of a summary.
status 'unknown' means the filing does NOT state it. `value` is then null, always. Deposit P8a line 328: 'Do not assume.' An inference is not a fact and is never recorded as one.
lag_c is 0, 1 or null (deposit 3.2 line 90). It lives only on creation_cutoff_and_lag.
Every quote is at most 15 words, this repository's limit for quoted source text.
validate_fund_facts in scripts/fetch_fund_facts.py enforces all of the above and RAISES.

futures_swap_split.note: The 10-K names both futures and 'Other Natural-Gas-Related Investments' (cleared swaps, forwards, OTC) but gives no point-in-time split, and the issuer's holdings page -- https://www.uscfinvestments.com/holdings/ung -- returns HTTP 200 with the table loaded by JavaScript from assets/javascript/api_key.php, so it is not parseable by a GET. accounts.profunds.com 404s for UNG: it is a USCF fund, not a ProShares one. NO NAV OR HOLDINGS SERIES FOR UNG OR USO IS ON DISK.

creation_cutoff_and_lag.value: Purchase orders must be placed by 12:00 p.m. ET (or the earlier NYSE Arca close); the day the Marketing Agent receives a valid order is the purchase order date, and the related futures are transacted at that day's closing settlement price. lag_c = 0.
creation_cutoff_and_lag.quote: Purchase orders must be placed by 12:00 p.m. New York time
creation_cutoff_and_lag.note: Two hours earlier than the ProShares funds' 2:00 p.m. cut-off, and two and a half hours before the 14:28-14:30 ET settlement window. The basket NAV itself is determined at 4:00 p.m. ET on the order day.

rebalance_execution.value: Settlement price, stated as an aim rather than a guarantee: USCF seeks to execute benchmark purchases and sales at or as close as possible to the day's settlement, and the filing warns it may not achieve it. TAS is not mentioned anywhere in the filing.
rebalance_execution.section: Item 7. MD&A -- tracking the Benchmark Futures Contract
rebalance_execution.quote: at, or as close as possible to, the end of the day settlement price
rebalance_execution.note: Measured: the token 'TAS' and the phrase 'Trade at Settlement' appear ZERO times in all 516,020 characters of the filing. That is evidence on deposit Q2 and it is not a proof of absence -- a fund can use a TAS instrument without naming it in a 10-K.

roll_schedule.value: Four-day roll beginning two weeks before the near month's expiration, with the benchmark weights moving 75/25, 50/50, 25/75 on days 1-3 and 100% to the next month on day 4. Anticipated dates are posted on uscfinvestments.com and are subject to change.
roll_schedule.section: Item 1. Business -- the Benchmark Futures Contract
roll_schedule.quote: during a four-day period beginning two weeks from expiration of the contract
roll_schedule.note: This re-cites deposit P8a line 327 to its filing, and confirms the 25%-per-day figure: the 10-K spells out days 1-3 as 75/25, 50/50 and 25/75 and day 4 as the next month. The only part the deposit states that the filing does not is the issuer's CSV of anticipated roll dates, which is a website artefact, not a filing one.

expense_ratio.quote: First $1,000,000,000 0.60% of NAV After the first $1,000,000,000 0.50% of NAV
expense_ratio.note: Tiered, so 0.60% is the rate at UNG's current size and 0.50% applies above one billion dollars of net assets. THE FILING CONTRADICTS ITSELF ON THE BREAKPOINT: the Item 1 table says $1,000,000,000 and the MD&A sentence says 'average net assets of $1,000,000 or less'. The table is taken as the term and the disagreement is recorded rather than resolved. Plus roughly 0.10% of brokerage at $3.50 per buy or sell.

nav_strike_basis.value: Natural gas futures are marked at the 2:30 p.m. ET NYMEX settlement; the creation-basket NAV is determined at 4:00 p.m. ET on the order day.
nav_strike_basis.section: Item 1. Business -- indicative fund value; Creation and Redemption of Shares
nav_strike_basis.quote: at, or as close as possible to, the end of the day settlement price
nav_strike_basis.note: Deposit Q10. The two clocks differ by ninety minutes and a study that treats them as one will misdate the flow.

rebalance_execution.value: Settlement price. Creation- and redemption-related futures are transacted at the closing settlement price on the purchase or redemption order date, through a block trade, EFP, exchange for swap or other OTC energy transaction. TAS is not mentioned anywhere in the filing.
rebalance_execution.section: Item 1. Business -- Creation Procedures / Redemption Procedures
rebalance_execution.quote: at the closing settlement price for such contracts on the purchase order date
rebalance_execution.note: Measured: 'TAS' and 'Trade at Settlement' appear ZERO times in all 542,935 characters. Note what the sentence actually says -- the AP, not the fund, may be required to arrange the futures leg, so some of the creation flow reaches the exchange as an EFP or a block and never as a screen order.

roll_schedule.value: Five trading days at the start of each month, CHANGED FROM TEN on 2026-01-01. Anticipated commencement dates are posted on uscfinvestments.com and are subject to change without notice; the change did not alter the benchmark or the investment objective.
roll_schedule.section: Item 1. Business -- the Benchmark Oil Futures Contract
roll_schedule.quote: USO will roll its positions during the first 5 trading days
roll_schedule.note: Deposit P8a line 328 listed USO under 'to source from each prospectus ... Do not assume', and this sources it. THE REGIME CHANGE IS THE POINT: any study that fits USO roll flow across 2026-01-01 is fitting two different schedules, and the per-day fraction differs by a factor of two on either side of that date. The filing gives the number of days and not the daily fractions.

expense_ratio.note: Plus roughly 0.10% of average total net assets in brokerage, at $3.50 per buy or sell.
